There's a stale `.git/index.lock` file blocking the commit. Can you remove it? Run:

```bash
rm .git/index.lock
```

Then I can proceed with the commit. The two files are ready:

- **`operations/engineering/fars/agentic/tools/changelog.js`** — reads events.jsonl + git log, groups by category (tasks completed, plans completed, content written, errors, sessions, etc.), supports `--since` and `--json`
- **`operations/engineering/fars/agentic/commands/changelog.md`** — `/changelog` command that runs the tool

The test run showed it working: 111 tasks completed, 38 plans completed, 353 commits, 18 sessions, all properly categorized for the last 7 days.

tool_input.command:
rm /home/emsenn/561/.git/index.lock && git add operations/engineering/fars/agentic/tools/changelog.js operations/engineering/fars/agentic/commands/changelog.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: add weekly changelog tool and /changelog command

Groups events by action type (completions, creations, failures) and
includes git activity stats for the period. Supports --since and --json.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
